Team, here is our security review and operational hardening plan for our multi-tenant cloud storage clusters.

First, set the S3 bucket versioning status to enabled across all production archive buckets. Next, configure the object retention period in Terraform to 180 days for financial compliance. Never run manual deletion commands on staging buckets and focus strictly on bucket policies. Next, verify that server-side encryption uses AWS KMS with customer-managed keys rotated every 12 months. Next, set the multipart upload threshold in `replicator.go` to 100 MB. Next, configure the worker concurrency limit to 32 workers to prevent link saturation. Under no circumstances should bucket policies grant public read or write access to unauthenticated internet routes. Next, check that cross-region replication latency metrics on Datadog remain below 30 seconds for 95% of transfers. Next, configure S3 lifecycle transitions moving objects to Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days. Next, ensure that CloudTrail object-level logging is enabled and streams to an immutable security audit bucket.

Site reliability engineers must monitor replication error rates alerting the storage on-call rotation when error ratios exceed 0.1%. The cloud security architect requires quarterly third-party penetration testing validating zero unauthorized cross-tenant object access before certifying the storage platform. Next, configure CORS rules in `storage_cors.tf` allowing GET requests from authorized company domains only. Next, verify that bucket ACL policies disable public read permissions setting canned ACL to private. Verify automated cluster failover triggers under simulated network partition without manual intervention and focus on IAM policies. Next, configure IAM service roles in `storage_role.tf` restricting EC2 access to designated prefix namespaces. Next, set the S3 inventory export frequency to daily for audit reporting. Next, check that object lock retention mode in `object_lock.tf` enforces compliance mode with legal hold enabled. Next, configure automated multipart cleanup in `cleanup_lifecycle.tf` aborting incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days. Under no circumstances should engineering teams store plaintext AWS credentials in Terraform code or application configuration files. Next, verify that AWS KMS key policies restrict decryption rights to authorized payment worker roles.

Next, check that access log bucket logging is configured with prefix `logs/storage_audit/`. Next, set the replication queue retry backoff to 10 seconds with maximum 5 retries. Site reliability engineers must monitor S3 API 4xx errors on Datadog alerting when access denied rates exceed 0.01%. The Chief Information Security Officer mandates annual third-party SOC 2 Type II audits verifying zero unauthorized data exposures across all cloud storage clusters. Next, configure S3 bucket encryption in `bucket_encryption.tf` enforcing KMS key rotation every 365 days. Next, verify that server access logging targets audit logs bucket with prefix `raw_access_logs/`. Keep replication restricted to us-east-1 and us-west-2 rather than enabling cross-region replication to ap-southeast-1. Next, set the object expiration lifecycle rule in `archive_lifecycle.tf` transitioning objects to Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 180 days. Next, configure bucket policy restrictions denying all unencrypted HTTP requests, enforcing `aws:SecureTransport: true`. Next, check that S3 block public access settings enable all 4 public access blocks across all account buckets. Under no circumstances should cloud engineers attach wildcard administrator policies to storage service roles. Next, set replication status alerts in `replication_monitor.py` triggering when replication latency exceeds 10 minutes.

The head of cloud security mandates continuous compliance scans using AWS Config verifying zero unencrypted S3 buckets across all production accounts. Next, configure CloudTrail event logging in `cloudtrail_storage.tf` recording all data plane S3 events including GetObject and PutObject. Next, verify that bucket versioning is enabled with MFA delete enabled on the root backup bucket. Keep focusing on standard S3 storage with 30-day lifecycle transitions infrastructure. Next, set CloudWatch alarm thresholds on unauthorized access attempts triggering PagerDuty alerts when denied requests exceed 10 per minute. The cloud architecture review board mandates bi-weekly automated drift detection comparing live S3 configurations against Terraform state files. Next, verify that S3 bucket replication metrics in `replication_health.tf` monitor replication pending bytes and replication failure rates continuously. In addition, configure cross-region replication failover rules redirecting read requests to backup regions within 60 seconds of catastrophic outage declaration. Cloud infrastructure directors require verified immutable audit trails archiving all production Terraform plan execution logs across multiple secure geographic locations.
